name: Stripe
description: Stripe payments become events: Placed Order for paid Checkout sessions (including delayed payment methods, once they succeed) and subscription invoices, Refunded Order for each refund, and Subscription Started and Subscription Cancelled. Customers who tick Checkout's promotional-emails box are subscribed to email; everyone else is held back from marketing.

signature_secret.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
signature_secret.help: Starts with whsec_. In the Stripe Dashboard: Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint → Signing secret.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.

In the Stripe Dashboard, go to Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint. Paste the webhook URL and choose these events: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, invoice.paid, refund.created, refund.updated, charge.refunded, customer.subscription.created, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted.
Copy the endpoint's signing secret (whsec_…) and save it as the integration's signing secret.
Send a test event from Stripe (or paste one into the Script tab's Test panel) and check the delivery log. Stripe's own retries of an event are recognized by its id and ignored.

To subscribe buyers to email, turn on Checkout's promotional emails consent (consent_collection.promotions = auto). Only people who tick the box are subscribed; everyone else is held back from marketing.

flows.name: Stripe: subscription win-back
flows.description: A day after a subscription is cancelled, asks what went wrong and invites them back.

content.subject: Sorry to see you go, {{ first_name|default('friend') }}
content.preheader: Tell us what we could do better

blocks.html:
Thanks for being a subscriber. If something wasn't right, reply and tell us; we read every answer.

You're welcome back any time.
